narration: In month {fork_month}, with rent gone and payday still days off, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, in month {first_bar_apart_month}. The ghost's money touched its lowest point in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the two lives were at their furthest apart, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion against a lost salary ended {safety_gap}, while its days of actually living ended {life_gap}.
